title: Guide
description: A to-do app that caps you at 3 meaningful tasks a day, so your deep work actually moves. No login.

title: Open Tab
description: Free, working web apps and games without any sign-up or installation requirement.

title: Hand It Off — a doodle you didn't plan
description: Draw something, send the link, and the next person adds to it. A pass-it-on doodle, no sign-up.

title: 12 Week Fitness Program
description: A guided 12-week, six-days-a-week workout plan with timers, rest breaks and progress tracking.

title: Abhyasa - Kannada Verb Drill
description: Spaced-repetition drills for Kannada verb forms, with hints, a reference chart and verbs you can edit.

title: Ballpark - A Fermi Estimation Studio
description: Practise Fermi estimates: break big unknowns into small guesses, with worked problems and AI hints.

title: Courage Compass
description: Daily prompts to practise asking for things, with a log of attempts, outcomes and what you learned.

title: Micro-Adventure Tracker
description: Small, doable adventures picked for you by theme. Plan one, tick it off, and watch your list grow.

title: NextFive Publisher
description: Write posts or short notes with images and publish them to your GitHub Pages blog from any browser.

title: Nuance — the adjective navigator
description: Find just the right adjective by browsing shades and registers of everyday words. Works offline.

title: Spontaneous Action Generator
description: Stuck or restless? Hit Surprise Me for a random quick action to break the loop. Add your own ideas too.

title: Subtext. (From NextFive)
description: Translate with nuance (casual or formal, literal meaning, alternatives) and save words to a review deck.

title: Wayfinder
description: A private, offline guide for working through a problem, from feeling stuck to a clear next move.
